title: GENOCIDE ARCHIVE OF RWANDA - ARSIP GENOSIDA RWANDA
comment: Welcome to the Genocide Archive of Rwanda website. Here you will find our digital collection of items related to the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda, pre-genocide history and post-genocide reconstruction processes. Our materials are also preserved and accessible at our physical archive which is located at the Kigali Genocide Memorial. http://genocidearchiverwanda.org.rw/index.php/Welcome_to_Genocide_Archive_Rwanda simak...
